nodes.author: Rémi Rampin, Vicky Steeves, Sarah DeMott

nodes.label: Entity-Relationship Diagram (erd.svg)
nodes.rationale: Tables: users, projects, project_members, documents, highlights, highlight_tags, tags, commands, alembic_version with 0..N / {0,1} cardinalities.

nodes.label: taguette.export scripting API
nodes.rationale: Export functions exposed under taguette.export 'for use in scripts and notebooks' (0.11).

nodes.label: Highlight Byte Offsets
nodes.rationale: Highlights stored as start_offset/end_offset in UTF-8 bytes skipping HTML tags; snippet denormalized into the highlights table so document text need not be re-extracted on each access.

nodes.label: Manage Collaborators Modal (privileges)
nodes.rationale: Permission levels: ADMIN (full), MANAGE_DOCS (no collaborator/project management), TAG (view & make changes), READ (view only).

nodes.label: Project View (main workspace)
nodes.rationale: Two-pane layout (left: Project info/Documents/Highlights tabs; right: rendered document). All state bootstrapped as inline JSON ('Avoid doing requests, this is 2018 and we are good at engineering').

nodes.label: Screenshot: Document View
nodes.rationale: Description from paper.md figure caption ('Document view, where highlights are created and associated with tags'); pixels not machine-analyzed (no vision support on this host).

nodes.label: Screenshot: Collaborator Management
nodes.rationale: Description from paper.md figure caption ('Adding collaborators through the interface'); pixels not machine-analyzed (no vision support on this host).

nodes.label: Screenshot: Exported Document in LibreOffice
nodes.rationale: Description from paper.md figure caption ('A highlighted document exported from Taguette and opened in LibreOffice'); pixels not machine-analyzed (no vision support on this host).

nodes.label: Base Layout (base.html)
nodes.rationale: Navbar (Home, project name, account dropdown/single-user mode), footer with license + support links; loads jQuery 3.3.1 and Bootstrap bundle.

nodes.label: Font Awesome 5 Brands (SVG glyphs)
nodes.rationale: SVG webfont: 390 brand-icon glyph definitions (500px..zhihu), units-per-em 512, bundled for the fa-all.min.css icon set.

nodes.label: Font Awesome 5 Free Regular (SVG glyphs)
nodes.rationale: SVG webfont: 151 regular-style glyph definitions (address-book..window-restore), units-per-em 512.

nodes.label: Font Awesome 5 Free Solid (SVG glyphs)
nodes.rationale: SVG webfont: 868 solid-style glyph definitions (ad..yin-yang), units-per-em 512; the weight actually used by most UI icons.

nodes.label: Document Conversion Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Calibre ebook-convert run as subprocess with 2-minute timeout; wvHtml for Word 97 .doc; bleach sanitization removes scripts/media to avoid XSS; reverse conversions used for export.

nodes.label: Free CAQDAS Motivation
nodes.rationale: Commercial CAQDAS is too expensive or does quantitative analysis on text; qualitative researchers without massive funds deserve free basic tooling.

nodes.label: robots.txt (SEO)
nodes.rationale: Disallow /project/ — project content is private user data and must not be crawled.

nodes.label: Alembic Migrations
nodes.rationale: Single-user mode auto-migrates (with SQLite backup); server mode refuses to start and requires `taguette migrate` to avoid surprise schema changes.

nodes.label: Database Layer (SQLite/PostgreSQL/MariaDB)
nodes.rationale: SQLite3 default in single-user mode, PostgreSQL for app.taguette.org, MariaDB tested; MySQL rejected because the tag-merge query fails (error 1093).

nodes.label: Frontend (Jinja templates + taguette.js)
nodes.rationale: Tornado's built-in template language is quite limited, so Jinja renders the HTML pages; all JavaScript kept in a single file static/js/taguette.js.

nodes.label: Live Editing (Long-Polling Sync)
nodes.rationale: Long-polling instead of two sync mechanisms: events sent to the originating browser too; the DB is checked first so a browser that was asleep catches up.

nodes.label: Server Layer (Tornado + SQLAlchemy + Jinja)
nodes.rationale: Single Python server holds business logic so the app runs both stand-alone on an end-user machine (no DB/account setup) and as an internet service.

nodes.label: Architecture Diagram (graphviz SVG)
nodes.rationale: Shows frontend(HTML,JS) <-> server(Python) via 'HTTP+JSON API' / 'Long-polling', server -> SQL database, server -> Calibre via 'Command-line'.

nodes.label: Localization (main + javascript catalogs)
nodes.rationale: Two catalogs: main for server strings, javascript served from /trans.js as a dictionary; browser language by default with per-user override.

nodes.label: Translation Guide (po/README.md)
nodes.rationale: Translate UI + terminal/help text; do NOT translate logging, exceptions, or API messages (destined to developers).

nodes.label: app.taguette.org Hosted Service
nodes.rationale: Running since March 2019 with about 2,000 monthly active users; initial OpenCollective goal was to cover the dedicated server cost.

nodes.norm_label: third-party service dependencies (ovh, sendgrid, sentry, aws)

nodes.label: Example Terms of Service (tos.html)
nodes.rationale: Plain-language summary lines ('We won't share your information, that would be rude.') precede each legal section; instance admins can optionally set their own TOS.
